Evaluate forecast accuracy

Source: R/metrics.R
accuracy.Rd

Computes a comprehensive set of scoring rules for a mortality forecast. When called with observed test data, evaluates out-of-sample accuracy. When called without test data, evaluates in-sample fit (fitted vs raw training observations).

Usage

accuracy(object, ...)

# S3 method for class 'mort_forecast'
accuracy(object, test = NULL, ...)

Arguments

object

A mort_forecast object.

...

Ignored.

test

Optional mort_data object containing observed mortality rates for the forecast period. If NULL, evaluates in-sample accuracy using fitted values and raw training data (both must be present).

Value

A named list with class mort_accuracy, containing:

mase_cell

Cell-level MASE across all (age, group) series.

mase_trend

Group-trend MASE.

mase_combined

Combined MASE (0.7 cell + 0.3 trend).

rmse_log

RMSE on the log scale.

mae

Mean absolute error.

coverage

Empirical coverage of 95 percent PI (if PIs present).

interval_score

Mean interval score (if PIs present).

crps

Empirical CRPS from simulations (if sims present).

n_ages

Number of age groups evaluated.

n_years

Number of years evaluated.

n_groups

Number of population groups evaluated.

type

"out_of_sample" or "in_sample".

model

Model name.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
# Out-of-sample: compare forecast against held-out observed data
accuracy(fc, test = holdout_data)

# In-sample: evaluate fitted vs raw training data
accuracy(fc)
} # }
